2610.09683.title: System Switch: When Should a Fast Decision Model Stop and Think?
2610.09683.paper_summary: Dual-process agents pair a fast policy with a slow deliberative model. In real-time settings the slow model usually runs continuously; in turn-based agents and robot planners it is invoked on events such as uncertainty or a detected failure. We study a fast learned actor that takes every decision and hands control to a reasoning vision-language model only when a gate opens, while the game keeps running. We use closed-loop Doom and the new open "System One" typed-decision models, served through a common llama.cpp interface. On 900 held-out questions, (i) zero-shot decision models from 0.15B to 9B parameters choose to collect items 1.6-1.8 times more often than chance among their errors, in any option order, although the order changes some models' accuracy; (ii) accuracy, calibration and sensitivity (how well confidence separates right from wrong answers) are distinct: models of similar accuracy differ widely in AUROC, and the confidence of the most sensitive one tracks which kinds of situation it fails, not which answers are wrong; (iii) offline, deferring the least confident 30% of decisions to a reasoning model gains over random deferral in proportion to the actor's AUROC (rank correlation 0.87); with actor and rate chosen on held-out games the gain is +0.13 [0.08, 0.18] with doomLaya's option order and +0.08 [0.02, 0.14] with shuffled options, and reasoning carries about half of it; (iv) in closed loop (33 games, three seeds) no variant reaches the exit. Committing to plans, the reasoner's or a fixed explore rule's, opens more doors and makes an actor that stands still play; with the rule the agent dies more often. Told that some doors need keys, the reasoner takes ordinary doors for locked ones, which the state cannot tell apart; without that knowledge it goes back to collecting. We release code, prompts, data and logs.
2610.09683.paper_summary_zh: 雙過程代理將快速策略與緩慢的深思熟慮模型結合在一起。在實時環境中，緩慢模型通常持續運行；在回合制代理和機器人規劃中，當出現不確定性或檢測到故障等事件時會被調用。我們研究了一個快速學習的行為者，它在每次決策中都會接管控制，僅在門打開時才將控制權交給推理的視覺-語言模型，而遊戲則持續進行。我們使用閉環Doom和新的開放式「系統一」類型決策模型，通過共同的llama.cpp介面提供。在900個保留問題上，(i) 從0.15B到9B參數的零樣本決策模型在其錯誤中選擇收集物品的頻率比隨機機率高1.6-1.8倍，無論選項順序如何，儘管順序改變了一些模型的準確性；(ii) 準確性、校準和靈敏度（信心如何區分正確與錯誤答案）是不同的：相似準確性的模型在AUROC上差異很大，而最靈敏的模型的信心跟蹤的是它失敗的情況類型，而不是哪些答案是錯誤的；(iii) 離線時，將最不自信的30%的決策推遲到推理模型，根據行為者的AUROC獲得的收益超過隨機推遲（排名相關性0.87）；當行為者和速率在保留的遊戲中選擇時，收益為+0.13 [0.08, 0.18]，使用doomLaya的選項順序和+0.08 [0.02, 0.14]，使用隨機選項，推理大約占了一半；(iv) 在閉環中（33場比賽，三個種子），沒有變體能達到出口。承諾計劃，無論是推理者的還是固定的探索規則，會打開更多的門，並使靜止的行為者進行遊戲；使用該規則，代理會更頻繁地死亡。被告知某些門需要鑰匙時，推理者將普通門視為鎖住的門，而狀態無法區分；沒有這種知識，它會回到收集物品。 我們發布代碼、提示、數據和日誌。
2610.09683.author: Gian Luca Bailo et.al.
